entities.summary: Takeshi Koike (b. 1968-01-26, Kaminoyama) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kaminoyama and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
